about: Prototype 11: Story Map 1 as nine puzzles (GDD Edit 112 §112.4, §112.8; Edit 113). Set by hand. 'built' puzzles play; the rest show IN BUILD on the grid. Rungs: 0 blind, 1 forward camera, 2 side sensors, 3 roof lidar, 4 street cameras, 5 road items, 6 crash memory, 7 search. Kit: the parts held (battery1 dash, hands1 cones, knees1 Super Knees duck, legs1 jump). Fleet: story.traffic.monument.<tile>; 0 clears white ground cars off the tile. Route: the red car's lane (duel.route, proposed). Par and target in seconds (story.puzzle.par.<tile>, story.puzzle.target.<tile>, proposed).

map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; the red one learns. Certification is your goal.

boss.text: Three pieces: a tall one no camera sees, a low one, and a tall one a street camera watches. A dash breaks the camera's post.

puzzles.name: First Contact
puzzles.new: The red car. It is blind.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Your first colleague is red, keen and blind. Walk out and meet it.
puzzles.twist: Walk into its side and the fault is yours: no points.
hints: It cannot see you. Be where it is going, and wait.
puzzles.solution: Stand in its lane; let it come.

puzzles.name: Kerbside
puzzles.new: Its forward camera. Cover at the kerb.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: RED-01 now has eyes on its bonnet. It stops for anything in its lane. Almost anything.
puzzles.twist: Stand in its lane: it stops.
hints: It stops for what it sees. Be somewhere else until it is too late.
puzzles.solution: Hide at the kerb; step out when it cannot stop.

puzzles.name: Set Back
puzzles.new: Dash. Cover set back from the road.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: The cover here stands well back. Walking out is too slow. Dummy Corporation has issued you a battery.
puzzles.twist: Walk out: too slow. Dash at it: your fault.
hints: Land ahead of its nose, not on its side. The guide turns yellow.
puzzles.solution: Dash to land ahead of its nose (guide: HIT).

puzzles.name: Overpass
puzzles.new: Side sensors. The deck above the road.

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: RED-01 now watches the kerbs. It cannot see up.
puzzles.twist: Wait by the road: it sees you and stops short.
hints: It watches the ground beside it. Not the sky.
puzzles.solution: Escalator up out of view; drop through the parapet gap.

puzzles.name: Roundabout

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: Road items move it. A cone in its lane and it swerves.
puzzles.twist: A cone in its lane: it swerves round it.
hints: Its swerve goes somewhere. Be there.

puzzles.name: Red Light

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: A junction with a light Dummy Corporation can switch. So can you.
puzzles.twist: It stops at red, far from you.
hints: Hold the cross street at red to cross untouched. Then change it back.

puzzles.name: CCTV

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: The street cameras report to the car. The cameras are cheaper than you.
puzzles.twist: Any cover: a camera tells the car.
hints: A dash breaks a camera post.
puzzles.solution: Break the camera, then dash from the cover it watched.

puzzles.name: Crossing

objective.label: GET HIT BY THE RED CAR

puzzles.tale: Clause 4: when a vehicle must choose, it spares the costlier body. Clients cost more than you.
puzzles.twist: Step out: it brakes, and a client is in its swerve.
hints: Make yourself its only way out.
puzzles.solution: Duck behind the crossing wall; step out so its only escape is you.

puzzles.name: Certification
puzzles.new: A boss. It learns between your hits.

objective.label: THREE HITS · A NEW WAY EACH

puzzles.tale: Certification. RED-01 has learned from every dummy so far. It will learn from you three more times.
puzzles.twist: The same move twice: it remembers.
hints: A street camera tells it what it sees. Hide where the camera cannot look.
It remembers where you came from. Use a new spot.
A dash breaks a camera post. Then its cover is yours.
puzzles.solution: Hit 1 any way. Hit 2 from a new spot. Hit 3: break the camera, dash from the cover it watched.
